metadata.title: Revert "feat: Add Vite watch mode to make dev for React app hot reload"
metadata.author: gcgoncalves

commits.message:
feat: add Vite watch mode to make dev for React app hot reload

- Update Makefile dev target to run Vite in watch mode (build --watch)
- Vite continuously rebuilds React app to mcpgateway/static/app/
- Python backend serves built files at http://localhost:8000/app
- Enable sourcemaps in vite.config.ts for debugging
- Fix cd client error by using subshells in Makefile
- Update stop-dev target to stop Vite watch process
- Graceful fallback to Python-only mode if npm not installed

Closes #4187

Signed-off-by: Vishu Bhatnagar <vishu.bhatnagar@ibm.com>
commits.author: Vishu Bhatnagar
